svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ADS9324 pinout, VQFN-64
svg.desc: Pinout of the ADS9324 in VQFN-64, top view: 64 pins and an exposed pad, each with its name, its electrical type as a colour and the driver hook that uses it.
svg.text: Top view, pin 1 marked. Colour is the pin's electrical type; the mono text outside is the port hook the driver uses for it. Datasheet: 4 Pin Configuration and Functions, Figure 4-1, p. 3.

* Not confirmed in the datasheet: pin 39 D7: the data sheet does not say how to terminate an unused data lane; pin 40 D6: the data sheet does not say how to terminate an unused data lane; pin 41 D5: the data sheet does

not say how to terminate an unused data lane; pin 42 D4: the data sheet does not say how to terminate an unused data lane; pin 43 D3: the data sheet does not say how to terminate an unused data lane; pin 44 D2: the

data sheet does not say how to terminate an unused data lane; pin 45 D1: the data sheet does not say how to terminate an unused data lane; pin 46 D0: the data sheet does not say how to terminate an unused data lane;
pin 49 DRDY/ALARM: unused-pin termination is not stated.
